boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 62 fills a 5×8 grid with smiley face blocks in the middle (free-sliding) and directional arrow blocks on the sides — blue left-arrows on the left, red right-arrows on the right. The smiley blocks can move freely, but the arrow blocks are constrained. Clear the top and bottom rows first, then work the middle smiley blocks, and finish with the side arrow blocks.
landmarks: Block Out Level 62 fills a 5×8 grid with smiley face blocks in the middle (free-sliding) and directional arrow blocks on the sides — blue left-arrows on the left, red right-arrows on the right.
The smiley blocks can move freely, but the arrow blocks are constrained.
Clear the top and bottom rows first, then work the middle smiley blocks, and finish with the side arrow blocks.

quickTips: The smiley blocks in the middle are free-sliding — use this freedom to clear paths for the directional arrow blocks.
Clear the top and bottom rows first to give the middle blocks room to move.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the top orange smiley blocks through the top exit to open the upper section.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the bottom green smiley blocks through the bottom exit to open the lower section.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Begin sliding the middle smiley blocks freely — they can move in any direction.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the blue left-arrow blocks on the left through the left exit as the middle opens.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the red right-arrow blocks on the right through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with any remaining smiley blocks trapped in the corners.

failurePoints: Clearing the side arrow blocks before the middle smiley blocks have room — the middle blocks get trapped.
Trying to clear the middle before the top and bottom rows are open, which jams the board.
